text:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — during onboarding call with Northbay they flagged 3 recurring friction points that are showing up across trial accounts.
Liam (PM): please list them, thinking about quick wins for the next sprint.
Maya (CS): 1) initial embed indexing takes too long (30-45m) when customers upload >2GB — blocks enablement. 2) per-route cost visibility is confusing for finance. 3) 'model switching' UI isn't discoverable so customers stick to default, causing regen work.
Harper (CSM): +1 on the indexing delay, also customers worry about partial failures and no retry feedback in the console.
Sam (Eng): interesting — is the 2GB case using the bulk API or UI upload?
Maya (CS): UI upload via the console; they tried the bulk API but prefer a GUI flow for non-technical buyers.
Ana (Product): thanks — that maps to two themes: reliability/feedback during long jobs, and cost transparency. We should separate: behavioral (UX) fixes vs infra fixes.
Liam (PM): can we get concrete asks from the customer so we can prioritize? e.g., a progress indicator + retry would be a low-effort UX patch.
Harper (CSM): customer quote: "We had to pause the demo because indexing was still running, and our finance lead couldn't explain the spike." — wants a progress bar and a place to see expected cost impact before upload.
Sam (Eng): provisional engineering notes: 1) surface async job status in console (ETA, retries) — small frontend + job-status API change. 2) consider chunked upload path to avoid giant single-worker jobs — more work.
Maya (CS): customer asked: can we add a checkbox to warn about estimated cost before confirming an upload?
Ana (Product): yes — scope: (A) pre-upload cost estimate + warning (B) job progress + retry UX (C) investigate chunked ingestion for longer-term.
Liam (PM): propose prioritization: P0: pre-upload cost estimate (quick ROI on renewal risk), P1: job progress + retry, P2: chunked ingestion (architectural). Thoughts?
Harper (CSM): agree — P0 will reduce finance surprises and likely improve demo conversions.
Sam (Eng): I can spike the job-status surface this week; ETA for frontend + API patch: 5 dev days. Chunked ingestion spike will take longer (2-3 sprints).
Maya (CS): action items: Sam to spike progress UI + API; Ana to draft proposed messaging flow for pre-upload cost estimate; Harper to collect 2 more customer quotes and link usage logs.
Liam (PM): add to product board and tag for next sprint planning.
signal-bot: created signal card #SIG-2026-178 for "Onboarding: upload cost visibility + job status" and linked to this thread.
Maya (CS): thanks — I'll update Northbay and flag to renewal owner that we have a short-term mitigation path. :thumbsup:
Ana (Product): can we also capture expected impact on renewal risk (qualitative) in the signal card? I can add a note.
Harper (CSM): adding: customer said they'd delay purchase decision until costs were clearer — that feels like a medium-term renewal risk.
Liam (PM): great thread. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Sam + Ana tomorrow to scope the P0 work.
Sam (Eng): ack, will bring an API sketch.
Maya (CS): closing loop — will post customer follow-up once we have the pre-upload mock.
